arxiv-2311-15826.title: GeoChat : Grounded Large Vision-Language Model for Remote Sensing
arxiv-2311-15826.creator: Kartik Kuckreja, Muhammad Sohail Danish, Muzammal Naseer, Abhijit Das, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan
arxiv-2311-15826.description: Abstract Recent advancements in Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown great promise in natural image domains, allowing users to hold a dialogue about given visual content. However, such general-domain VLMs perform poorly for Remote Sensing (RS) scenarios, leading to inaccurate or fabricated information when presented with RS domain-specific queries.

arxiv-2407-06217.title: On Simulation of Power Systems and Microgrid Components with SystemC-AMS
arxiv-2407-06217.creator: Rahul Bhadani, Satyaki Banik, Hao Tu, Srdjan Lukic, Gabor Karsai
arxiv-2407-06217.description: Abstract Cyber-physical systems such as microgrids consist of interconnected components, localized power systems, and distributed energy resources with clearly defined electrical boundaries. They can function independently but can also work in tandem with the main grid. Power system converters and their control loops play an essential role in stabilizing grids and interfacing a microgrid with the main grid.

arxiv-2502-18683.title: Robots, Chatbots, Self-Driving Cars: Perceptions of Mind and Morality Across Artificial Intelligences
arxiv-2502-18683.creator: Ali Ladak, Matti Wilks, Steve Loughnan, Jacy Reese Anthis
arxiv-2502-18683.description: Abstract . AI systems have rapidly advanced, diversified, and proliferated, but our knowledge of people’s perceptions of mind and morality in them is limited, despite its importance for outcomes such as whether people trust AIs and how they assign responsibility for AI-caused harms. In a preregistered online study, 975 participants rated 26 AI and non-AI entities.

arxiv-2503-19120.title: Where is this coming from? Making groundedness count in the evaluation of Document VQA models
arxiv-2503-19120.creator: Armineh Nourbakhsh, Siddharth Parekh, Pranav Shetty, Zhao Jin, Sameena Shah, Carolyn P. Rosé
arxiv-2503-19120.description: Abstract Document Visual Question Answering (VQA) models have evolved at an impressive rate over the past few years, coming close to or matching human performance on some benchmarks. We argue that common evaluation metrics used by popular benchmarks do not account for the semantic and multimodal groundedness of a model’s outputs.

arxiv-2505-07064.title: ParaView-MCP: An Autonomous Visualization Agent with Direct Tool Use
arxiv-2505-07064.creator: Shusen Liu, Haichao Miao, Peer-Timo Bremer
arxiv-2505-07064.description: Abstract While powerful and well-established, tools like ParaView present a steep learning curve that discourages many potential users. This work introduces ParaView-MCP, an autonomous agent that integrates modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with ParaView to not only lower the barrier to entry but also augment ParaView with intelligent decision support.

pmc-12656893.title: Gut Virome: What's the Role in Irritable Bowel Syndrome?
pmc-12656893.creator: Francesco Rettura, Christian Lambiase, Andrea Bottari, Fabio Filippini, Luca Giacomelli, Mauro Pistello, Massimo Bellini
pmc-12656893.description: The gut virome, an integral but still poorly understood component of the gut microbiota, is emerging as an important player in the pathophysiology of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). Recent evidence suggests that alterations in virome diversity and phage–bacteria interactions contribute to gut dysbiosis, immune modulation and gut barrier dysfunction in IBS.

pmc-12931374.title: Identification of a novel TLR7 gain-of-function variant that underlies systemic lupus erythematosus
pmc-12931374.creator: Aiswarya Sethumadhavan, Charles Mariasoosai, Natsuko Yamakawa, Nicolas Chamberlain, Matthew A. Deardorff, Shintaro Funaki, Takaki Asano, Jean-Laurent Casanova, Hedieh Torabifard, Bertrand Boisson, Eric Meffre
pmc-12931374.description: Sethumadhavan, Mariasoosai, Yamakawa et al. report a novel TLR7 gain-of-function (GOF) variant associated with autoimmunity in a male patient, which further highlights TLR7's essential role in SLE pathogenesis. The L840R mutation may increase TLR7 binding with UNC93B1, which is a molecular mechanism that was not previously described for other TLR7 GOF or UNC93B1 mutations.

pmc-13380720.title: Hepatitis C virus can induce gene expression changes associated with hepatocarcinogenesis
pmc-13380720.creator: Tuyana Boldanova, Fredrik Trulsson, Fahim Ebrahimi, Andrej Benjak, Matthias S. Matter, Aleksei Suslov, Stefan Wieland, Charlotte K.Y. Ng, Markus H. Heim
pmc-13380720.description: Background & AimsIn vitro studies suggest that hepatitis C virus (HCV) may have a direct oncogenic effect, independent of the well-established indirect mechanisms of hepatocarcinogenesis driven by chronic necroinflammation, compensatory regeneration, and fibrosis. However, evidence supporting such mechanisms in human liver tissue remains limited. This study aimed to determine whether HCV contributes directly to hepatocarcinogenesis in human liver samples.

pmc-13527501.title: Altered pain-related attention engagement in individuals with chronic musculoskeletal pain: Evidence from EM-ERP
pmc-13527501.creator: Zhou Yang, Jiehong Liao, Xingyu Zhang, Yong Liu, Xing Kang, Todd Jackson
pmc-13527501.description: ObjectivesWe investigated neurocognitive mechanisms of pain-related attentional control in individuals with chronic musculoskeletal pain.MethodsBy simultaneously recording eye movements and event-related potentials (ERPs), we examined pain-related attentional control in a sample with chronic musculoskeletal pain (N = 26) and a matched pain-free control group (N = 26).
